title: Translation of a card
description: A file in data/translation/card/, such as data/translation/card/li/lightning-bolt/ja.json. The values of one card as one language prints them, written only where they differ from the English. The type line keeps the parts of the card's type line, and the rules text keeps one entry per ability, so each value stays tied to the part it translates.

lang.description: The language of this translation, such as ja.

name.description: The card name as printed in this language.

flavor_text.description: The flavor text as printed in this language.

history.description: Records of official corrections to this translation. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.

type_line.description: The parts of the type line as this language prints them.

rules_text.description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The rules text of that ability as printed in this language.
